evidence.reason: The current I1 contract requires an error object on stdout only in machine mode (`--json`), where stderr must stay empty. `src/selfhost/observe-prs.ts` has no flag parsing and this catch is not in `--json` machine mode, so writing the failure message to stderr while setting exit code 1 is not a current-contract violation. The finding relies on a quoted “Every operation invocation writes machine-readable JSON to stdout” rule that is not in the current contract and would enlarge the error-artifact requirement beyond its stated `--json` scope.
